title: ORNL Pathways to Computing Internship Program (PCIP) - Summer 2027
summary: The Pathways to Computing Internship Program at Oak Ridge National Laboratory is a 10-week summer program offering undergraduate students hands-on experience in computer science, computational science, and mathematics. Participants work alongside research staff and gain access to ORNL's world-class computing facilities. The program provides a weekly stipend, housing assistance, and travel reimbursement for non-local students.
citizenship: Currently enrolled full-time undergraduate students returning for Fall 2027.

title: The Green Teams Program 2027
org: Montclair State University, PSEG Institute for Sustainability Studies
summary: Full-time, 11-week summer internship where teams of five students from different majors work on sustainability projects for companies, nonprofits, towns and community groups. Interns train on campus, visit host sites and finish with a report and group presentation.
citizenship: Upper-level undergraduates from any major with an interest in sustainability

title: CALIBIR Summer Research Internship
org: Wake Forest University School of Medicine
summary: The CALIBIR Summer Research Internship is an NIH-funded 10-week program offering undergraduate and master's students hands-on research experience in translational artificial intelligence and biomedical informatics. Interns participate in professional development, seminars, and collaborative research projects while receiving hourly pay and on-campus housing.
citizenship: Enrolled US undergrad/master's students, 18+, min 3.0 GPA, completed at least two semesters, not graduating before May 2027.

title: Biomedical Informatics (BMI) Summer Internship 2027
org: University of Arizona College of Medicine – Phoenix, Department of Biomedical Informatics
summary: Remote summer internship (May 24 to August 13, 2027) where up to six interns work with faculty on AI, data science and informatics projects. The application window runs January 11 to February 5, 2027; pay is provided.
citizenship: Second- or third-year undergrads or grad students in data science, CS, biomedical engineering, computational biology or related

title: Computer Science Research Internship Program
org: Yale University, Department of Computer Science
summary: Yale CS matches students with faculty for research internships; location, dates and stipend depend on the project, and many projects can be remote. Applications are reviewed as they arrive, with December 15 suggested for summer projects.
citizenship: Students pursuing a bachelor's, master's or PhD in computer science or a related field

title: DSI Summer Lab 2027
org: University of Chicago Data Science Institute
summary: Interdisciplinary, project-based summer research program in data science for undergraduates and Chicago-area high school students. Undergrads must be enrolled in college in fall 2027 and know at least one programming language.
citizenship: Undergrads enrolled in fall 2027 (not graduating seniors) with some programming experience

title: Spatial Computing Intern, Summer 2027
summary: Onsite summer internship with INL's Spatial Computing team building AI for autonomous systems such as robotic labs and inspection platforms. Work covers 3D perception, SLAM, vision-language-action models, digital twins, edge AI and AR/VR interfaces.

title: Research Intern, Summer 2027
summary: About 12 weeks of research (between May 17 and August 30) in mechanism design, cryptoeconomics, distributed systems or cryptography, contributing to papers and prototypes. Pays $4,500 a week plus a housing stipend; hybrid, New York preferred.
citizenship: Mainly PhD students; exceptional master's and undergraduate students are also considered

title: Cech Fellows Program (Summer Undergraduate Research)
summary: Paid nine-week summer program (June 14 to August 12, 2027) placing undergraduates in HHMI life-sciences labs across the US, including Janelia. Stipend is $15,000 at a host institution or $12,000 at Janelia with housing.
citizenship: Rising juniors or seniors, full-time at a US institution, 18+; no visa sponsorship

title: Research Internship, Open Ecosystem (2027)
summary: Paid 12-week, on-site research internship on Ai2's open foundation models such as Olmo and Molmo; interns usually publish papers. Undergraduate pay is listed at $94,320 a year (pro-rated).
citizenship: Mostly PhD candidates; master's and undergraduate students with a strong research background considered

title: Broad Summer Research Program (BSRP) 2027
org: Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard
summary: Fully funded nine-week program (June 7 to August 6, 2027) where undergraduates do a computational or experimental biomedical research project with a mentor. Includes leadership and science-communication sessions and a final presentation; stipend $5,400.
citizenship: Science, CS, engineering or math majors at US four-year colleges, GPA 3.2+, graduating Dec 2027 or later

title: Undergraduate Complexity Research (UCR) 2027
summary: Ten-week summer research program in complexity science (May 30 to August 7, 2027). Participants must attend all ten weeks.
citizenship: Students in a bachelor's or associate's program graduating December 2027 or later

title: Computing Internships (Spring and Summer 2027)
summary: LLNL's list of computing internship postings, including undergraduate, community college, DevOps, HPC cluster engineering and Data Science Institute roles for 2027. Each posting has its own requirements and closing date.
